_doc: E5-b6-lowrank-kd: student = E4 (average of steps 5k-8k) compressed to < 7M by dnd/lowrank.py (whitened SVD); trained with the E0 recipe (two-view noisy data, one 192-D SF2 head, head-only phase) plus KD from the same E4 average (cached clean-crop embeddings): embedding 1 - cos x 2.0 (as in the C2X recipe) + relational SmoothL1 (beta 0.1) x 1.0. The student starts in the teacher's embedding space, so the KD projection starts at identity.
